answer: Sybil keys cannot stack a majority on their own answers. Each submission is handed off at an intake wharf to five established graders chosen by H(epoch seed, answer txid, seat). Any two seats that share an invite ancestor within four hops, or a single funding output, are rejected and redrawn. Graders first commit H(score, salt) and may reveal only after that window reaches its zenith. A mismatched reveal or a packed clan slashes the bond recorded beside a saffron tag and collapses those keys to one vote.
